verdict.rationale: Ghostty's docs claim a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events (macOS only), which would be a documented automation surface. A hands-on runtime probe of Ghostty 1.3.1 found only config and +action CLI commands and no remote-control/IPC interface, concluding that an external script or agent cannot send commands to or read output from a running instance; no OpenAPI spec was found either. libghostty is an embedding library for building terminals, not an API for driving Ghostty itself. Missing for 10: verified working external control of a running instance, cross-platform (non-macOS) API, in-depth API reference docs, a way to read terminal output programmatically.
